body:
I have been prescribed Zopiclone (1x7.5mg) for insomnia for several years now and my doctor has suggested that I try to come off it.  In fact each repeat prescription I have had has come with a note advising me to try and do without.  Three weeks ago I finally managed to do this and as a result I have a box of the stuff lying around with no use for it.
I had heard somewhere that Zopiclone is sometimes used by heroin addicts when they cant get anything else and so thought that it would have some kind of recreational potential.  So, the other day, I took two 7.5mg pills.  I was expecting something along the lines of a benzodiazapine, like Valium, as I understand that these drugs work on the same receptor.
After about 30-40 minutes I noticed slight effects, I was  feeling pleasantly relaxed. At T+54 minutes I took a third 7.5mg pill.  After another hour I decided to end the experiment and not take any more.  I was a little groggy, and not in a very interesting way, it was not nearly as pleasant as Valium.  Overall I was disappointed  and will not be doing it again.
